summary: Proposes optional extensions to POP3 so a workstation can read messages from a discussion group server in the same way it reads from a mailbox server. It builds on the earlier POP3 memo. Every extension it describes is optional, and the memo asks for discussion.

eli5.summary: Besides your own mailbox, you may want to read a big group chat board. This adds extra ways for the same mail-fetching tool to read that board too.

questions: how to read news groups with pop3
